source: Ed4 C.6.5 to C.6.8, pp.C-71 to C-74; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2
description: With an empty ladder, constants or not, no recommendation is sent: the peer keeps getting CAPABILITY.
note: Flow as drc-rx-capability-records-ed4: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, which records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long, block 256 bytes) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, so 21 headers whose EOWs are placed as interp C-1260 says: the top priority of Table C-25 first, then the rotation of the repeating set from its start. Earlier bursts (each burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) carry PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105) or a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (counted as a D_PDU error, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (interleaver 101, C-0462, C-0469), MAX-SEGMENT 0xA00 + value. drc.table has every constant but an empty ladder and no thresholds: no calibration (core-architecture.md 9, phase 7, design shape item 6), so nothing is measured or recommended (interp C-1271) and every header to 0.0.1.3 carries CAPABILITY, 0xF01 (C-0426), as in drc-rx-capability-records-ed4.
